en.headline: Kai Tak stadium wall lights up nightly ahead of Asian Games
en.dek: A 30-minute display on the main stadium facade runs at 8pm until 24 October, with free match screenings due to start when the Nagoya Games open on Saturday.
body: Kai Tak Sports Park is running a nightly Asian Games light show on the main stadium facade as Hong Kong athletes prepare for the opening of the Aichi-Nagoya Games on Saturday.

The park said the 30-minute display is scheduled from 8pm to 8.30pm between 15 September and 24 October, covering the Asian Games and the Asian Para Games. Images of table tennis, cycling, fencing, football and esports appear on the wall, along with the slogans "Support Team HKG citywide" and "GO! TEAM HKG". The park lists Shing Fung Road Park in Kai Tak, the Kai Tak Bridge in Kowloon Bay and the Hoi Sham Park waterfront in To Kwa Wan as viewing spots.

From 19 September, selected events are due to be shown free on a large screen in the atrium of Kai Tak Mall 2. A pop-up display of the Hong Kong team's opening-ceremony and medal-ceremony uniforms is scheduled at the same mall until 6 October, from 11.30am to 8.30pm daily.

On opening day, 19 September, Kai Tak Sports Park and Flyover Kai Tak are due to stage a family sports day at the Sports Centre workshop space, with activity zones for rugby, karate, pickleball, judo and fencing. Hong Kong is sending about 580 athletes across 38 sports.

zh.headline: 啟德主場館外牆每晚上演亞運燈光展
zh.dek: 燈光展每晚8時至8時30分播放至10月24日，名古屋亞運周六開幕後，零售館將免費直播指定賽事。
body: 啟德體育園正於主場館外牆每晚上演亞運主題燈光展，為周六開幕的愛知・名古屋亞運會造勢。
園方表示，燈光展由9月15日至10月24日每晚8時至8時30分播放，涵蓋亞運會及亞殘運會賽期。外牆會呈現乒乓球、單車、劍擊、足球及電競等項目畫面，並展示「全城上下撐港隊」及「GO! TEAM HKG」字句。園方列出的觀賞點包括啟德承豐道公園、九龍灣啟德橋及土瓜灣海心公園海濱長廊。
由9月19日起，啟德零售館2中庭大電視將免費直播指定賽事。同場「撐港隊」期間限定店展出港隊開幕禮出場服及領獎服，展期至10月6日，每日上午11時30分至晚上8時30分。
開幕當日（9月19日），體育園聯同「飛越啟德」將在啟德體藝館習藝坊舉辦親子運動同樂日，設欖球、空手道、匹克球、柔道及劍擊等體驗區。香港今屆派出約580名運動員出戰38個項目。
